subject: Request: expedited onboarding without PO for GreenByte (trial integration)
messages:
From: Oliver Hayes <oliver@greenbyte.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@greenbyte.co
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding question: GreenByte trial — PO required?

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the integration looks promising for our data pipeline test. Our procurement team usually requires a PO to activate billing, but this is a short (6-week) trial and we were hoping Redwood could allow billing via invoice without an immediate PO.

We can provide the onboarding form, W-9, and a short supplier risk questionnaire; we just don't have a signed PO in place yet (internal process lag). Can you advise what minimum evidence we need to run the trial and whether an invoice-only onboarding path (temporary) is possible?

Ideally we'd be able to start the trial next week.

Thanks —
Oliver Hayes
Head of Partnerships, GreenByte
Attachment: greenbyte_onboarding_form_v1.pdf (PDF, 210KB)
Attachment: greenbyte_risk_answers.docx (DOCX, 48KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver@greenbyte.co>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding question: GreenByte trial — PO required?

Oliver —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Short answer: for trials we sometimes allow a temporary invoice-only path, but we need approvals from procurement/finance and a minimal evidence pack. I looped in Kimberly (procurement lead) and Marissa (onboarding ops) to confirm what they'd require for a temporary allowance.

What's included already (thanks for sending): onboarding form, risk answers, and W-9. If you can also share a contactable POC for credit checks and a high-level statement of expected spend for the 6 weeks, that will help speed review.

Proposed next steps: Kimberly to confirm checklist + conditional approvals, Marissa to open the onboarding ticket and reserve a quickstart slot. If procurement approves a time-bound invoice-only route, we'll generate an invoicing agreement and a 30-day evidence hold.

Couple logistical notes: we treat invoice-only exceptions as temporary (max 60 days) and they require a named approver from finance to authorize the waiver.

—Ben
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Oliver Hayes <oliver@greenbyte.co>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: expedited onboarding without PO for GreenByte (trial integration)

Thanks for the context, Ben / Oliver. Oliver — welcome. I reviewed the attachments you sent and ran an initial risk pass. To consider a temporary "invoice-only" onboarding (no PO at activation) we need the following minimum evidence and commitments: 

- Completed vendor onboarding form (received).
- W-9 (received).
- Completed supplier risk questionnaire (received initial answers; we need the signed doc on company letterhead).
- A named billing contact and a finance approver at GreenByte for the temporary exception (name, title, email).
- Expected maximum spend during the 6-week trial (USD).
- Agreement to a time-bound allowance: Redwood's invoice-only pilot approvals are 45 days max; any extension requires re-approval.
- DocuSign signature on our "Temporary Invoice Onboarding Agreement" (I can generate the DocuSign once finance sign-off is in place).

If GreenByte can provide the missing signed questionnaire and billing approver contact before EOD Friday (PST), I'll run this through the procurement exception ladder. I'll record the request under deal HB-2027-451 and ask finance for a fast-path reviewer. 

Notes on caveats: 
- Temporary exceptions carry an upstream risk hold; if any red flags appear during the trial (credit or compliance), we will pause access until a PO is provided.
- This exception affects our portal billing flow; Marissa, please mark this onboarding as "invoice-path — exception pending" and reserve the sandbox slot for August 18.

Oliver: attaching the temporary agreement template for transparency (will send DocuSign once internal approval is obtained).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: temp_invoice_onboard_template.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Oliver Hayes <oliver@greenbyte.co>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: expedited onboarding without PO for GreenByte (trial integration)

Kim / Ben —

I reviewed Kimberly's summary and the attachments. Given the low expected spend and GreenByte's posture (they agreed to a short trial window and provided the onboarding form and W-9), finance will provisionally approve a 45-day invoice-only onboarding subject to: 

1) GreenByte returns the signed supplier questionnaire on letterhead and names a finance approver (email + phone).
2) GreenByte accepts Redwood's "Temporary Invoice Onboarding Agreement" via DocuSign (I will require the signer to affirm payment terms of Net 30).
3) We run a quick credit/ID verification (low-friction; our partner does a soft-check).

If all three items are completed by 5pm PT on Friday, I'll sign off and instruct billing to enable the invoice route and issue the first trial invoice at the end of month. If anything is missing after Friday, we pause until a PO is in place.

Oliver — please upload the signed questionnaire and confirm the billing approver to the HubSpot record at: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/GB-451 and reply-all with the approver's contact. Marissa — please create the onboarding ticket and mark sandbox slot for Aug 18 pending Naomi's final sign-off.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
